high_level_description: This image is a tweet from the Western Naval Command of India, dated one day prior to the screenshot being taken. The tweet announces that eight submarines operated together during a recent exercise in the Arabian Sea, showcasing their operational readiness. The tweet includes several hashtags and mentions of other official accounts related to the Indian Navy. The tweet is accompanied by four photographs of submarines at sea.
